# Placard ID

> Explore the nine DOT hazard classes and their placards, with examples, then train on RCRA and DOT hazmat shipping, manifests and emergency response.

Placard ID (https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Hazardous Waste Manifest, First Responder Awareness training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $58.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). The shipping paper for hazardous waste. Enroll: https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize, isolate, notify: using placards and the ERG. Enroll: https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

## Guides

- [Using the Emergency Response Guidebook (ERG)](https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/guides/using-the-erg): From placard to protective actions in under a minute.
- [When is a placard required?](https://placards.hazwoperosha.us/guides/when-is-a-placard-required): The basics of placarding hazardous waste and hazmat shipments.
